rows.label: qst640203_msg0002
rows.name:
Thanks to everyone, it went fine this
time, po!

rows.label: qst640203_msg0004
rows.name:
Thanks to Idaten-sama's lightning-fast
delivery, Samuron-sama was apparently
delighted.

rows.label: qst640203_msg0005
rows.name:
Idaten, if you're willing, I'd like to
keep asking you to handle
deliveries...

rows.label: qst640203_msg0007
rows.name:
I still want to sneak a bite
sometimes, but Idaten enjoyed seeing
how happy the customers were, po!

rows.label: qst640203_msg0008
rows.name:
And I realized I can buy local
specialties wherever I deliver and
bring them back, po!

rows.label: qst640203_msg0009
rows.name: I see. That's a good idea.

rows.label: qst640203_msg0010
rows.name:
Yuuou-sama, Idaten-sama, we have many
delivery requests from all over Alst.

rows.label: qst640203_msg0011
rows.name:
I'll let you know as they come in, so
please help whenever you have time.

rows.label: qst640203_msg0013
rows.name:
I'll work hard for delicious food,
po!!

rows.label: qst640203_msg0016
rows.name:
Thank you. Because of you, we can
deliver sweets to many more people
now.

rows.label: qst640203_msg0017
rows.name:
You're welcome. Supporting UO Sweets
is my job.
